items.Sentence: Prior to connection to the CLS, the Discharger inspects all individual onsite wastewater systems (i.e. septic tanks, electrical, alarms, pumps, etc).
Require that septic tank filters be cleaned on a regular basis.
Prior to connection to the CLS, the Discharger inspects all individual onsite wastewater systems (i.e. septic tanks, electrical, alarms, pumps, etc).

Pumping of solids is required whenever the solids clear space or scum clear space is inadequate (less than three inches and less than eight inches, respectively). Homeowners and business owners must have the septic tank pump out in a timely manner by a licensed septic hauler.
The wastewater generated from this new development will discharge to the Phase 2 leachfield.
